main_topics.reason: The user explains that ongoing tiredness and fog despite a reportedly normal TSH are why they are considering dietary changes and asks whether their dose could be off.
The user asks whether going gluten-free has evidence behind it and later discusses how to test whether it helps their symptoms.
The user learns testing should happen while still eating gluten and includes asking about screening in their plan.
The user asks whether their levothyroxine dose may explain the fatigue and agrees to have it reviewed.
The user says the gluten idea appealed because it was something they could control themselves while waiting on doctors.

output.summary: The user asked whether a gluten-free diet might help Hashimoto's and explained they still feel tired and foggy while taking levothyroxine. The assistant discussed celiac screening before changing diet, a tracked gluten-free trial if appropriate, and reviewing the dose and other possible causes with a doctor; the user endorsed a plan to do those steps in that order.
